stories.title: FIR against BJP BLA over 'false' Form-7 applications, first in Telangana

en.title: FIR against BJP BLA over 'false' Form-7 applications, first in Telangana
en.summary: A BJP Booth Level Agent has been charged with filing false voter deletion requests in Telangana. Election officials and Congress leaders allege the fraudulent applications aimed to illegally remove valid voters from electoral rolls, prompting the Chief Electoral Officer to direct district officials to take action.

stories.title: Rahul, Priyanka among 260 detained during INDIA bloc march to ECI in Delhi

en.title: Rahul, Priyanka among 260 detained during INDIA bloc march to ECI in Delhi
en.summary: Police detained 260 protesters, including Congress leaders Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi and 10 MPs, during an INDIA bloc march to the Election Commission after demonstrators breached barricades. The Gandhi siblings were later removed from a sit-in at Akashvani Bhawan.

stories.title: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh pitches indigenous aero-engine capability for AMCA

en.title: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh pitches indigenous aero-engine capability for AMCA
en.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh announced plans for a second production line for Shakti engines during the delivery ceremony of the 2,000th aero-engine by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited. The initiative aims to support indigenous aerospace capabilities for India's Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft.

stories.title: Smriti Mandhana replaces Harmanpreet Kaur as India captain: ‘Very special honour’

en.title: Smriti Mandhana replaces Harmanpreet Kaur as India captain: 'Very special honour'
en.summary: Smriti Mandhana was appointed captain of India's women's cricket team following Harmanpreet Kaur's resignation. Mandhana, who previously led India in T20Is and ODIs, takes over the role with the Board expressing confidence in her leadership while Harmanpreet remains in the squad.

stories.title: Smriti Mandhana named India women’s captain as Harmanpreet Kaur steps down

en.title: Smriti Mandhana named India women's captain as Harmanpreet Kaur steps down
en.summary: Smriti Mandhana has been appointed as India's women's cricket captain following Harmanpreet Kaur's decision to step down from the role.

en.title: Rajnath Singh stresses on self-reliance in aerospace sector as HAL delivers its 2,000th aero-engine
en.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh emphasized self-reliance in aerospace as Hindustan Aeronautics Limited delivered its 2,000th aero-engine.

stories.title: Bhuvneshwar returns as India announce T20I and India A squads for New Zealand series

en.title: Bhuvneshwar returns as India announce T20I and India A squads for New Zealand series
en.summary: Bhuvneshwar Kumar was recalled to India's T20I squad for the New Zealand series, with Shreyas Iyer named captain and rising players including Rishabh Pant and KL Rahul selected for the India A team.

en.title: CBI files corruption case against Punjab CM's aide after High Court order
en.summary: The CBI registered a corruption case against six individuals including public servants and associates following a High Court directive.

en.title: India squad for New Zealand series: Bhuvneshwar Kumar returns in T20Is; Jurel to lead IND A
en.summary: India has announced its squad for an upcoming New Zealand series, with Bhuvneshwar Kumar returning to the T20I team and Jurel selected to lead the India A side.

stories.title: Ernakulam district administration directs AWHO to take over Chander Kunj apartments from October 12

en.title: Ernakulam district administration directs AWHO to take over Chander Kunj apartments from October 12
en.summary: The Ernakulam district administration has instructed AWHO to assume control of Chander Kunj apartments starting October 12, after AWHO missed an earlier handover meeting. The administration plans to sign a demolition contract with a Mumbai-based firm this week.

stories.title: DRDO tests high-altitude platform, keeps it at 20 km for over 30 minutes

en.title: DRDO tests high-altitude platform, keeps it at 20 km for over 30 minutes
en.summary: India's Defence Ministry has successfully tested a lighter-than-air high-altitude platform designed for long-duration stratospheric surveillance, maintaining it at 20 kilometers altitude for over 30 minutes.

en.title: 'A skunk': DMK questions Rahul Gandhi over stand on SIR deletions in Tamil Nadu
en.summary: The DMK has criticized Rahul Gandhi regarding his position on SIR deletions affecting Tamil Nadu, using sharp language to question his stance on the issue.

en.title: Sebi says Jane Street's appeal for more details a delaying ploy
en.summary: India's securities regulator has characterized Wall Street trading firm Jane Street's request for additional documents as a delay tactic in response to market manipulation allegations related to Nifty Bank derivatives trading.

stories.title: Current gold prices provide a better entry point as central bank demand supports the outlook, says Tata Mutual Fund

en.title: Current gold prices provide a better entry point as central bank demand supports the outlook, says Tata Mutual Fund
en.summary: Gold has declined significantly from January highs, but Tata Mutual Fund considers current prices attractive due to ongoing central bank purchases, fiscal concerns, and geopolitical risks supporting long-term demand.

en.summary: Motilal Oswal has initiated a Buy rating on Molbio Diagnostics with a ₹1,800 target price, citing growth potential from the company's Truenat molecular diagnostics platform deployed across 90+ countries.

en.title: MFs kept buying these 10 microcaps for 2 straight quarters; stocks surge up to 70% in 3 months
en.summary: Mutual funds sustained buying of 64 microcap companies over two consecutive quarters, with ten stocks gaining 25%-68% in three months, reflecting strong institutional investor interest in the segment.

stories.title: Banks vs NBFCs: Which stocks could benefit as RBI eyes rate hike for first time in 3 years?

en.title: Banks vs NBFCs: Which stocks could benefit as RBI eyes rate hike for first time in 3 years?
en.summary: An anticipated interest rate increase by India's central bank for the first time in three years is expected to affect banks and non-bank financial companies differently. Banks with floating-rate assets may gain while NBFCs could face margin pressure, with several major lenders identified as potential beneficiaries.
